deviations_from_card: Mirroring every viseme change at once was not enough on its own: with any cap it still left 1 of 55 midpoints over 0.05 (aa at frame 240, a level jump 0.28 to 0.73 inside a vowel on the frame after a send). So a 'shape change' also covers the mouth target (mouthTarget(viseme, level), which Main's driver aims at) moving more than 0.1 since the last mirrored signal. The cap is a hard sliding budget: at most 8 per 200 ms window, so no second goes over 40, with a 12.5 ms minimum gap. The steady refresh stays 30 Hz (new FACE_REFRESH_HZ); a 40 Hz refresh took the whole budget and went over 40 (42 per second). The window length is sensitive: 100 ms and 250 ms each held a closure back on the calm line, 1000 ms starved the refresh for up to 348 ms under an every-frame voice; 200 ms passes everything. This is recorded in the ADR. Phase changes still ignore the cap. Grew the set by comment-only edits in driver.ts and src-tauri/src/face.rs (stale '30 Hz' text), plus one closing line in ADR 0120's Measured section.
